# Shared visual foundations

Vendored from `~/Development/useclis/design-system/` on 2026-09-11 at the user's request. Fonts, color, typography, spacing, and radius tokens are kept verbatim so the projects use the same visual vocabulary. Repo League's layout lives in `dist/style.css` and uses these tokens; no dependency on another local checkout is needed to build or deploy.

Inconsolata is self-hosted, with the SIL Open Font License alongside the font files. The UseCLIs MIT notice is in `../licenses/useclis-MIT.txt`. Keep these notices when updating the assets. Refresh this token snapshot deliberately when adopting future UseCLIs changes.

Use neutral cards, compact tables, dark primary actions, and green source/metric accents. Developer avatars stay circular, profiles emphasize people and projects, and profile claiming remains a primary action. Do not invent historical growth charts from the current one-time snapshot.
